meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能帮你为 AI 代理在微软 Entra 中创建专用身份体系:先建身份蓝图,再为每个代理实例建独立身份,并配置令牌交换与权限。
howto.when: 当你要求为 AI 代理创建或管理微软 Entra 代理身份,或提到“Agent Identity Blueprint”“fmi_path”“OBO”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 为 AI 代理创建一个 Agent Identity Blueprint
say.note: 会调用 Graph 创建蓝图对象。

say.text: 给某个代理实例授予 User.Read.All 应用权限
配置 fmi_path 两步令牌交换
say.note: 按参考文档生成父令牌与 Graph 令牌。

howto.what_en: Claude provisions and manages Microsoft Entra Agent Identities: it creates an Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configures OAuth token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or manage Microsoft Entra agent identities, or mention Agent Identity Blueprint, fmi_path token exchange, or OBO.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint for an AI agent.
say_en.note: Sends a Graph request to create the Blueprint object.

say_en.text: Grant User.Read.All application permission to an agent instance.
Configure a two-step fmi_path token exchange.
say_en.note: Follows the reference to get parent and Graph tokens.
